b015fa4234.q: How did Dr. Judith Borger start Concierge Medical Arts while working full-time as an ER doctor?
b015fa4234.a: Dr. Borger started with a $40,000 budget as a side business while maintaining full-time ER work. She initially sublet a room from a salon and spa on her days off, then transitioned to a small medical office suite with two treatment rooms in a medical office complex. As the practice grew, she gradually reduced her ER shifts from full-time to 10 shifts per month, then worked part-time for a long time, eventually hiring another physician to fill those hours. She reinvested all initial earnings back into the business and built incrementally rather than attempting to acquire all equipment and services at once.

She served as Principal Investigator for Novavax, Moderna, Regeneron, and other COVID vaccine and therapeutic trials, using the research income to continue paying her three employees (a nurse, esthetician, and virtual assistant) despite the practice being closed.
